author: Multiplayer Everything
name: Madness: Project Nexus

steps: Press Play online. A message shows your room code; send it to your friend. For three or four players use Host a room for 3 or 4 players under Other ways to connect: the game starts once everyone has joined.
Your friends type the code in Join by code, or pick your room in the Rooms list.
Click LAUNCH, wait for the menu, then pick Story Mode or Arena Combat and New Game. Friends can click the menus too.
In Story, click a stage, then PROCEED. In Arena, name your character, click ENTER ARENA, then BEGIN; each friend is in My Squad with their own stats and gear.

keys.key: W A S D or arrows

keys.does: Dodge or block. Use doors and panels.
Bullet time, when the bar has charge.

tips: Everyone has their own camera, HUD and aim. Any player can use a door, and it takes the team along.
If you die you get up after 8 seconds while anyone else is up. If everyone is down, the game spends a life or the mission fails.
If a friend leaves, their character carries on as an AI teammate. If the host leaves, the game ends.

description: Madness: Project Nexus (Classic) (Michael Swain and Matt "Krinkels" Jolly, 2012): fight through the story or the arena with up to 3 friends, each with their own character, camera and mouse.
